limits: ActualGPIO drive/slew/package IBIS and full Tab5/Core layouts are unavailable; source-pad fast-edge stress remains an explicit uncertainty.
Internal board lengths and package/via parasitics are sensitivity ranges, not measured extraction.
Single-pair crosstalk and assumed shared-return model do not certify every simultaneous-switching configuration.
Stable12V operation differs from brownout; K50 PGOOD does not guarantee Core input>=4.5V.
operating_conditions: Initial1MHz only; DATA setup/hold>=250ns; DIR turnaround>=500ns in each direction.
FPGA LVCMOS33 weakest4mA/SLOW; Tab5 weakest drive. Verify real pin edges on first hardware.
Both rails stable>=350ms, preferably500ms, before manualARM and handshake.
No Core hotplug; stop clocks and safe-state IO>=300us before intentional power-off; reinitialize FPGA/DDR after brownout.
